correctness.rationale: Project weak edges along a lower-triangular feedback ordering: earlier projections are equal around any directed cycle by blockwise acyclicity, and a later projection uses one constant effective growth vector. Induction contradicts distinct full cycle vertices; converse embeds any local cycle by zero extension. A complete four-support two-species sign proof excludes cycles for negative diagonal and positive determinant. Positive diagonal Lyapunov witnesses combine across feed-forward blocks by Schur complements for arbitrary coupling magnitude. The exact 4x4 witness and 3x3 cutoff are verified by checker.py, which also passed 660 seeded exact-rational samples; finite trials are not substituted for the general proof.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The global generalized-dominance test requires spectral radius below 1, but the A4 comparison radius is 2. Every diagonal Lyapunov witness for A4 has weighted-skew norm at least 2, whereas the sufficient four-species threshold is tan(pi/10)<1. Hence neither inspected sufficient theorem implies acyclicity of this covered example. Their results remain valid and different; no claim of exhaustive coverage of all prior literature is made.

value.rationale: Exact universal feedback-decomposition theorem motivates a local-to-global structural criterion for weak invasion cycles, independent of arbitrary-size feedforward coupling. The sharp 2-versus-3 SCC cutoff is natural for the ecology of rock-paper-scissors heteroclinic cycles. The worked 4x4 example lies beyond two closely related global sufficient conditions and admits a direct VL certificate, demonstrating genuine mathematical use of the theorem.
